notes.gpt-5.3-codex-spark: Alias to gpt-5.3-codex because upstream publishes token pricing on the gpt-5.3-codex key
notes.gemini-3-flash-a: Antigravity session data records gemini-3 models with an '-a' suffix (gemini-3-flash-a, gemini-3-pro-a); alias them to the canonical gemini-3 models
notes.deepseek-flash: Deliberately NOT aliased: DeepSeek Harness reports its default route as deepseek-flash, which its catalog names DeepSeek-V41-Flash. LiteLLM publishes no v4.1 key (bundled snapshot or upstream main), and deepseek-v4-flash is the earlier V4 model at its own much lower rates, so any alias would silently bill V4.1 traffic at another model's prices. Fuzzy matching is blocked so the row stays visibly unpriced until a real key exists; the published V4.1 rate card is listed in site/src/content/docs/sources/dsh.mdx for use with --pricing-overrides
notes.kimi-for-coding: Deliberately NOT aliased: the managed kimi-for-coding endpoint maps to kimi-k2.5 or kimi-k2.6 depending on the event timestamp. The kimi adapter resolves that fallback itself; a config-provided kimi-for-coding model stays unpriced rather than mispriced
